title: Periodic v0.4 QIF lifecycle audit
description: Run bounded QIF checks after every lifecycle stage and a full acceptance audit before v0.4 release.
completion_criteria: Record plugin isolation, compatibility, reference integrity, traceability coverage, determinism, performance, and security evidence after TASK-100 through TASK-106.
Block v0.4 release on failed AC-01..AC-12, untrusted evidence handling, nondeterministic traces, or legacy regressions.
Track quantitative 100/1000/10000 element benchmarks before the release gate.
success_criteria: Each stage has a dated docs/aof QIF evidence document.
Final v0.4 readiness report links every acceptance criterion to reproducible evidence.
